g.text: Quad simplification: three local operators that keep every face a quad
engine/src/geometry/HalfEdgeMesh + QuadSimplify. Numbers next to vertices are valences (ideal: 4 inside, 3 on a boundary).
a and c merge into w at the midpoint of the
diagonal (then projected on the input surface).
ab is glued onto cb and ad onto cd, so the
faces -1, vertices -1, edges -2: V - E + F unchanged.
b and d lose one edge each; w collects 4 + 4 - 2.
Rotations and relaxation then repair the valences.
Two quads sharing v-u form the hexagon
v x1 x2 u y1 y2. Replace v-u by the other
diagonal x1-y1: u and v lose one edge,
x1 and y1 gain one. Face and vertex counts
s has valence 2: its two faces (blue, orange)
share two consecutive edges A-s and s-C.
Dissolve both edges and s: two quads become
one quad A B C D.
faces -1, vertices -1, edges -2: V - E + F unchanged.
A and C lose one edge each (5 -> 4).
